## Goal

One shared WebSocket per signed-in session, hash routing in the signed-in
shell, and the board list with the new-board form.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `frontend/src/live.tsx`, `frontend/src/live.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/boards/BoardList.tsx`, `frontend/src/boards/BoardList.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/App.tsx`, `frontend/src/App.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/styles.css` (new) and `frontend/src/main.tsx` (import it)

### Steps

1. `live.tsx`: `LiveProvider({token, children})` calls `connectSocket` (ticket 002) once per token and closes it on unmount; keeps `status` and whether it has ever been open; a listener set for events. `useLive()` returns `{subscribe(boardId | null), status, everOpen, onEvent(listener) => unsubscribe}`. `Reconnecting` rule: `everOpen && status === "closed"`.
2. `App.tsx` signed-in shell: wraps in `LiveProvider token={token}`; header as before; a `<p role="status">Reconnecting…</p>` under the header when the rule holds; `route` state from `parseRoute(location.hash)` updated on `hashchange`; `{name: "boards"}` -> `BoardList`; `{name: "board", id}` -> a placeholder `<p>Board {id}</p>` that ticket 006 replaces with `BoardView`.
3. `BoardList.tsx`: loads `api.listBoards()`; shows `Loading…`, then a list of links `<a href={boardHref(id)}>{name}</a>` or `No boards yet`; reloads when `onEvent` delivers `boards.changed`. A form: input labelled `Board name`, button `Create board`; on success `location.hash = boardHref(detail.id)`; an `ApiError` shows its message in `<p role="alert">`.
4. `styles.css`: a simple layout: header bar, columns side by side in a horizontally scrolling row, cards as boxes. `main.tsx` imports it.
5. Run `make verify` and make it pass.

### Tests to add

- `live.test.tsx` (use `installFakeWebSocket`): one socket per token; events reach listeners until they unsubscribe; `everOpen`/`status` transitions; unmount closes the socket.
- `BoardList.test.tsx` (use `stubFetch`): empty list text; links with hrefs; create navigates (check `location.hash`); validation error in the alert; a `boards.changed` from the fake socket reloads the list.
- `App.test.tsx`: add: `#/` shows the board list; setting `location.hash = "#/boards/3"` and dispatching `hashchange` shows the board route; `Reconnecting…` appears after open then server close, not before the first open.
